stages.mythic: Edit the concept and go much further. Keep the mighty crenellated stone tower, its machicolations, its balconies and doors, the iron beacon frame. Remove both guards completely and remove the smoke patches. On the merlons, two steel helmets rest where the guards stood, a spyglass on its tripod points out, the bronze horn stays on its bracket, knotted rope and iron rungs run up the wall. The towering element: the tower is far taller than the previous stage, two thirds higher, a slender needle of stone that fills the top of the canvas, with extra stacked storeys of lit windows and balconies, its crown flaring wider than its shaft. On top, an enormous black iron beacon cage, as wide as the crown, burns with a very tall column of pale gold and white flame. Strong magic layer, clear by day and by night: from the flame two long straight beams of pale gold light reach far out to the left and right inside the canvas, and a slow ring of large pale embers circles the cage.
